more_info.overview: Penicillin G potassium is the potassium salt of benzylpenicillin. It belongs to the penicillin antibiotic family and is a different salt preparation from penicillin G sodium, procaine or benzathine. This entry preserves a historical antimicrobial designation. The general description concerns a medicinal compound and does not establish a typical current application as an ingredient added to human food.
